What not to paste into AI: a 60-second privacy check for small businesses

Before you hit enter, scan for 5 things: card and bank numbers, passwords and login codes, customers' names and contact details, staff health or HR details, and anything under NDA.

Then swap them for tags like [CUSTOMER] and [ORDER]. AI only needs the shape of the problem to write a good reply.

Copy this:

"Write a short, warm reply to this customer. Keep the tags as they are. Message: [PASTE CLEANED MESSAGE]"

Fill the real details back in your email app, not in the chat. And read the draft before sending: if it says "I've asked for a refund", make sure you have.

Send this to someone who still pastes whole emails into AI. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.

Save this for later. 📌
